# Reverend Jo

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v3 c26 P14](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0014)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c39 P40](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0040)</sub>
- **Role:** Minister  <sub>[v3 c26 P14](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0014), [v3 c27 P28](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0028)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jo  <sub>[v2 c27 P19](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0019)</sub>; Jonas  <sub>[v2 c24 P8](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0008)</sub>; The Reverend Jo  <sub>[v3 c29 P10](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

He is an ugly young man with a big, loose-jointed figure and absurdly long legs. He has lank tow-colored hair, green eyes, a big mouth, and an intellectual brow above inspired eyes. His face is clean-shaven, and he possesses a lovely, appealing voice.

_Sources: [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P11](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0011), [v2 c24 P15](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

He is deeply earnest, spiritual, and dedicated to his calling. Though good-tempered and fond of laughing and joking, he possesses an underlying earnestness and nobility of soul. He is humble, earnest, and deeply conscientious regarding his ministerial duties.

_Sources: [v2 c24 P12](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0012), [v2 c24 P15](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0015), [v2 c25 P13](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0013), [v2 c27 P20](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0020)_

- Ugly  <sub>[v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)</sub>

- To serve God and do good as a minister  <sub>[v2 c24 P19](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0019)</sub>
- To serve the poor in the slums  <sub>[v2 c27 P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029)</sub>

## History

Jonas Blake attended Redmond College and St. Columbia to prepare for the ministry. While spending a summer in charge of the Prospect Point Mission Church, he met Philippa Gordon at his boardinghouse. Despite his ungainly appearance, his earnestness, spiritual depth, and beautiful preaching won her affection. After completing his theological studies, he took charge of a mission church on Patterson Street in the slums. He eventually married Philippa in June following her graduation, and later attended the wedding of Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe at Green Gables, where he delivered a moving prayer. Afterwards, he and Philippa settled into their new life and ministry together.

_Sources: [v2 c24 P9](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0009), [v2 c24 P12](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0012), [v2 c24 P15](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0015), [v2 c27 P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), [v3 c26 P14](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0014), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c39 P40](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0040), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043)_
